title: Make Actions CI faster than t3code (all Theo tricks allowed)
body:
Operator grant (2026-11-06, verbatim): "wszystkie triki od theo są dozwolone szefie, to musi być superior tool".
Baseline: KRN Actions CI median PR 451 s / main push 475 s (gh run list), #247 run 42228642474 ~174 s start->Check; t3code PR median 226 s. Recon: .krn/runs/lead/ci-actions/t3code-recon.md.
Do (measure each, keep only what cuts push->Check wall-clock or flakes):
1. Faster runners (Blacksmith 4/8 vCPU as t3code) — needs the Blacksmith GitHub App installed on krn-works: operator action, ask once with a ready link.
2. Cache the toolchain (node/pnpm/mise pnpm install, Go with cache: true) instead of mise install per shard.
3. Wider change detection: docs-only (**/*.md outside spec) skips Test; keep Check fail-closed (skip ok only when changes says false).
4. Isolation (bubblewrap/sysctl/apt) and Go only on shards/paths that need them; then rebalance shards (3-4 vs 6-8, slowest shard 129 s) by recorded durations (#244 / t-3trwjr9 planner).
5. Sparse checkout + fetch-depth 2 in Changes; concurrency cancel-in-progress already present.
6. Later: test-task cache with verify-hits.
Proof: median push->Check over >=10 PR runs before/after in .krn/runs/lead/ci-actions/speed.md; target <= t3code median.
Also move rules render + krn task check to local preflight only if CI keeps an equivalent cheap Lint step (rules are gate inputs; decide by measurement).
